item.coloph: mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin skal (bskal)pa sa sbrul lor gter grogs bde chen rig 'dzin sgrol ma'i rten 'brel sna drangs te hUM chen 'gro 'dul pad ma gling pas gangs can zhing du gnas kyi khyu mchog du gyur pa sman mor 'dod dgu rin chen dpungs rdzong gi zhol gsang ba tsi rta dbyibs nas gter zhal phyes te slar bka' rgya bkrol ba'i tshe bstan 'dzin sems dpa' yongs kyis bskul ngor gtan la phab grub pas thams cad kun du byin rlabs ye shes nus pa'i dpal du 'bar ba gyur cig thog ma'i yi ge pa ni nyag gzhi a dkar bstan 'dzin gyis sor bcu spyi bor sbyar te bris pa dge zhing 'phel bar gyur cig/
